description: Write the SHELL of a key location: a space with a setting and optionally a text grid map. mode=CREATE — a new location (name, description, ambient are required); mode=UPDATE — editing an existing one, what is not sent does not change. POIs and hazards are not part of this: after CREATE add them one by one with addLocationPoi / addLocationHazard in the same response (the calls execute in order).
name: addLocation

mode.description: CREATE — a new location (the textId is not yet taken); UPDATE — editing an existing location by location.textId

location.description: Location shell (textId, name, description, ambient, grid?, interactives?) — without POIs and hazards

textId.description: Slug identifier of the location, format [a-z0-9-]+. mode=CREATE — a new one (no such location yet); mode=UPDATE — an existing location.

name.description: Title: "Crater of the Star Forge", "The Baron's Throne Room". CREATE — required; UPDATE — do not send if you are not changing it.

description.description: General description of the space: what kind of place it is, what the players see right at the entrance. 2-4 sentences. CREATE — required; UPDATE — do not send if you are not changing it.

ambient.description: Atmosphere and physics: light, sound, smell, scale. CREATE — required; UPDATE — the object replaces ambient entirely, do not send if you are not changing it.

light.description: Lighting: "dusk", "bright daylight with dusty streaks", "dark, only torches by the doors", "pulsing light of rune columns".

sound.description: Sound background: "silence and dripping water", "the roar of machines and shouting", "distant chanting of monks", "crackling fire in the hearth".

smell.description: Smell (optional): "the smell of burnt metal and sweat", "ozone and perfume", "rotting seaweed". Helps immersion a lot.

scale.description: Scale/dimensions: "a hall 100×80 ft, ceiling 100 ft", "a cave 30×30 ft", "an open crater, diameter 300 ft". Helps the planner estimate distances for movement/spells.

grid.description: Text map (optional; for tactical locations). UPDATE — the object replaces the grid entirely; edit a single row with updateLocationGridRow, the legend with addLocationLegendEntry/removeLocationLegendEntry.

widthCells.description: Map width in cells = number of characters in each row.

heightCells.description: Map height in cells = number of rows.

mapGrid.description: Text map. One symbol = one cell. Rows are separated by a real newline (`\n` in a JSON-encoded string = a real newline character). The service automatically normalizes accidental double-escapes (a literal `\n`) and adjusts widthCells/heightCells to the actual grid. The map holds only static terrain and objects; mark the encounter participants' starting positions with a separate symbol + a legend entry with relatedTextId pointing to the participant.

legend.description: Legend: every symbol used in `mapGrid` is described by a separate entry. An entry has: name (a short name — for the UI/planner), description (a full description with mechanics), relatedTextId (optional — to an interactive/hazard/POI/participant).

symbol.description: Symbol — EXACTLY ONE character (a letter a-z/A-Z, a digit 0-9 or one of +-*=/|:;,~^@#%&). Case matters: 'H' and 'h' are different symbols. By itself it means nothing — the meaning is in `name`+`description`. Within one map a symbol must be unique; on different maps the same symbol may mean different things.

name.description: A short artistic caption for the PLAYER over the map (optional, STINGY — 0-4 per map): "Isolde's Altar", "Well", "Forge". ONLY for key visible buildings/objects. WITHOUT name: base terrain (floor/walls/water), decorative props, the HIDDEN (traps/caches — the caption would spoil them) and "starting positions" (the party's entry point is a property of the visit, settled by tokens, not by the map).

description.description: Full description with mechanical details: "a stone wall 5×5×10ft, AC 18, 20 HP, immune to poison and psychic, collapses when HP is lost", "an oil barrel — partial cover (+2 AC); when hit by fire it ignites in a 10ft radius for 3d6 fire". Must be enough for the turn planner to run the scene without consulting a PDF.

relatedTextId.description: textId of the related entity — if the symbol denotes an interactive (`location.interactives[].textId`), a hazard (`location.hazards[].textId`), a POI (`location.pointsOfInterest[].textId`) or an encounter participant. Null if the symbol denotes plain terrain (floor/wall/cover with no special rules).

cellSizeFeet.description: Size of one cell in feet. 5 by default (D&D standard). For large-scale maps (crater, battlefield) — 10/20 ft.

orientation.description: Orientation: "N=up", "entrance from the south". Optional, but desirable for battles where direction matters.

interactives.description: Interactive objects of the combat arena. CREATE — the initial list; UPDATE — the list replaces all interactives entirely, do not send if you are not changing it.

name.description: Title: "Oil Candelabra", "Bridge Support Chain", "Water Sluice Lever", "Alchemical Barrels", "Swinging Rope".

gridPosition.description: Position on the map: "row 5, col 12" or "x:12, y:5". If the object is spread out (wall/chain) — a zone description.

description.description: Description: what it is, what it looks like, what makes it noticeable. 1-2 sentences.

trigger.description: Activation trigger: what the player (or enemy) must do. "Cut the rope (Athletics DC 12)", "Atk +5 vs AC 13", "Set it on fire with a fire spell", "Push (Athletics DC 15)", "Use key X". Must be achievable in combat.

effect.description: Activation effect: what happens after the trigger. Concretely — DC/damage/area/timing. "The chandelier falls onto cells B3-D5, 22 (4d10) bludgeoning, DC 15 Dex saving throw for half", "The portcullis drops, blocking the south exit for 1 minute", "The barrels explode: 3d6 fire in a 10ft radius".

usableBy.description: Who can use it: PARTY (the party only), ENEMIES (the enemies only), BOTH (both sides — the enemies too can cut the chain to drop it on the party). Who can use an interactive object in the arena: Par=the party only (the heroes' lever), Ene=the enemies only (an enemy ritual/device), Bot=both sides (a shared lever/altar).

oneShot.description: Whether it is single-use (`true` — after activation the object is spent, for example a fallen chandelier) or can trigger repeatedly (`false` — a lever can be used several times).

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description: Add ONE environmental hazard to an existing location. The only way to record a hazard: addLocation has none. Editing a hazard — removeLocationHazard + addLocationHazard.
name: addLocationHazard

name.description: Title: "Acid Fumes", "Lava Field", "Floor Snare Trap", "Magical Sleep".

telegraph.description: Telegraph: a noticeable sign of danger **before the player steps in**. "The water is bright turquoise, acrid fumes", "cracks in the floor, a dark crust", "the hum is growing". Without it the danger turns into a "gotcha" — a punishment for the player's inattention.

trigger.description: Trigger condition: "a creature within 10ft of the water", "weight >100 pounds on the plate", "opening the door without dispelling the charm", "6+ rounds in the zone".

effect.description: Effect under targetLevel: "DC 15 Con save, 21 (6d6) acid damage on a failure, half on a success", "fall 30ft taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage", "polymorph into a sheep for 1 hour".

waysToAvoid.description: At least 3 independent ways to detect/bypass/disarm. "Perception DC 12 to notice the cracks", "Detect Magic reveals the outline", "Jump over the zone (Athletics DC 14)", "Use the ring of resistance".

justification.description: Justification in the fiction: why the hazard is here — a link to the inhabitants' scheme, the nature of the place, history. "Acid seeps from a cracked rune stone under the star", "Brimskarda set it up to hold the dragon". Helps the planner fit it into the narrative.

escalation.description: Spread rule for escalating hazards (advancing water/fire/gas/collapse): "expands by 5ft each round", "doubles damage after round 3", "after 2 rounds the zone covers the whole map". Null — a static hazard. Creates time pressure in space: drives fighters into the desired zones.

escalationTrigger.description: Escalation start condition: "when the alarm is raised", "after round 3", "when the boss is below 50% HP", "when a column is broken". Null — the escalation is active from the start of the scene. Fill in if `escalation != null`.

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

name: addLocationLegendEntry

description.description: Description of the entity the symbol stands for

textId.description: Slug identifier of the POI, format [a-z0-9-]+. Unique within the location.

label.description: Display label: "1", "A", "BOSS", "N". The same as in `grid.cells` if the POI is on the map.

name.description: POI name: "Broken Bridge", "Acid Lake", "Altar of Isolde".

description.description: Description: what the players see/find/can do. 2-5 sentences. Includes game-mechanical details (check DCs, effects) where appropriate.

gridPosition.description: Position on the map: "row 5, col 12" or "x:12, y:5". Null if the POI is not on the grid (for example, for a location without a grid).

closesTaskId.description: Optional. ID of the task or issue that is FULLY resolved by THIS call — pass it OPTIMISTICALLY when you are confident in the arguments. If the call returns an error, the wrapper itself will NOT close the task. Don't use it for partial progress; for multi-tool tasks, close via completeTask after the final step.

description: Record a new task for yourself as a result of self-review. Available ONLY in the SELF_REVIEW phase. After adding all tasks call transitionTo into the working phase — the frame will execute them there.
name: addTask

description.description: What exactly needs to be done

description: Mark the task as done. Use this tool after you have performed all the actions described in the task or fixed the problem found by the setter.
name: completeTask

reason.description: Optional: closing reason/comment. Required for "decision items" of the checklist (for example, refusing a book promotion): such an item is closed by a SEPARATE call with an explicit reason, not silently in a common batch.

description: Mark several tasks as done in one call. Use for going through the working phase's checklist in a row (for example, closing several 'chk-*' items) when there are no intermediate decisions between them. If an idea appears along the way — close them one by one via completeTask. REVIEW items ('rev-*', the self-check phase) are NOT closed by this tool: each requires a separate completeTask with a verdict-specific in reason, batch closing is rejected.
name: completeTasks

description: Transition to another state (phase) of work. Call it once the current phase's work is complete — as the LAST call of the SAME response that finishes that work (when the phase rules allow the transition). The switch is applied at the END of this response: every other call in the same response still runs in the CURRENT phase, so it is safe to finish the phase's work and request the transition together. Do not spend a separate response on a lone transition call, and do not place new work AFTER the transition expecting the new phase.
name: transitionTo

description: Update ONE row of the location's text map (mapGrid) in place. Cheaper than addLocation(mode=UPDATE) with grid — no need to push the whole matrix again. After the replacement the whole grid is rechecked (equal row lengths, orphaned symbols, etc.) — on violation the change is rolled back with an informative error.
name: updateLocationGridRow

row.description: New row content. The length must match the grid width (widthCells); symbols — only from the legend.
